customer_question: Our Salesforce steps failed with CF-503 three times this month, and every time your status page said connectors were degraded. We pay $999 a month for Enterprise and our sales ops lost days of work. I have chased this twice already without a real answer. I want a service credit.
resolution: Escalated to billing at high priority as a credit request with repeated contact. Evidence attached: platform status showed the connectors component degraded during each failure window, and the customer's Salesforce authorisation was valid, so re-authorising was not needed. Support did not promise a credit. The billing team reviewed the incident history, a billing manager decided on the credit, and the customer was contacted within the Enterprise 4-hour response time.
